Game Overview

Flappy Halloween Run puts players into a halloween experience centered on navigate through Halloween-themed obstacles using precise taps to keep your character airborne. Dodge flying witches and birds in this endless challenge, where every second counts. Test your reflexes and aim for the highest score, but beware—one wrong move ends it all!

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Flappy Halloween Run is easy to pick up. Navigate through Halloween-themed obstacles using precise taps to keep your character airborne. Dodge flying witches and birds in this endless challenge, where every second counts. Test your reflexes and aim for the highest score, but beware—one wrong move ends it all!
